description.value: Steam Pot Cafe is a food service reportedly located within the McLean Mill National Historic Site, a 12.8-hectare former sawmill and logging operation in the Alberni Valley that was designated a national historic site of Canada in 1989. The surrounding site features 35 heritage buildings, a restored steam-driven sawmill, and trail access including the Log Train Trail which welcomes hikers, cyclists, and equestrians. Whether the cafe still operates under this name or has been rebranded to 'Mill Canteena' is unconfirmed.
